note: SCB's 2024 household categories are kept separate rather than forced into a binary owner/renter split: 38 % live in an owner-occupied small house, 21 % in a tenant-owned apartment in a multi-dwelling building, 29 % in a rented apartment in a multi-dwelling building, and 12 % in other forms. The visual groups the first two as 59 % clearly identified ownership categories, while retaining the 12 % other category. Housing-cost shares of disposable income are medians: rental 27 %, tenant-owned apartment 21 %, owner-occupied small house 18 % (SCB 2024). Bostadsförmedlingen: 894,592 registered on 31 Dec 2025; apartments allocated in 2025 had an average queue time of 9.0 years, or 12.4 years in Stockholm municipality. Young-adult figures are from Hyresgästföreningen 2025 and are described as results in that survey, whose method has changed between editions.
